evidence.observation: 2.99 Torr at start of growth, consistent with ramp plateau ~2.96-3.00
Monotonic rise to 3.276 Torr (~0.085 Torr/120 s) over 4 events
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not caused by the argon flow
Temperature holding at 749-750 °C after a normal overshoot; the heater is behaving normally
O2 exhaust sensor not installed; cannot distinguish air ingress from restricted exhaust

args.missing_evidence: To tell exhaust blockage from seal leak: step the Ar flow or briefly close the inlet and watch how pressure responds (base-pressure/leak-up test), check the exhaust line/pump, or use an O2 reading if one is available.
